name: Roles, teams, subagents, and model policies
userOutcome: The user can define reusable agent roles and teams, assign models and tools, and constrain parent and subagent behavior.
productionDataSource: Versioned role, team, tool, model, review, budget, and subagent policies.
errorBehavior: Preserve edits, show exact policy conflicts, and prevent publication of invalid or privacy-weakening configurations.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not allow unlimited recursive subagents.
Do not mutate a role version used by an active run.
Do not let prompts grant tools.
Do not silently use disallowed models.
acceptanceTests: Preserve old role version for active work.
